verdict.rationale: The Guichet unique is an online filing platform, so registrable outbound webhooks are a fair axis for it. The evidence only shows dashboards and in-portal progress tracking. There is no documented webhook registration or outbound HTTP callback for filing events. The keyless recherche-entreprises GET probe is a separate state API and an adjacent pull mechanism, not event subscription.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
